definitions.explanation: A feeling of blaming oneself for something that went wrong. A deep, internal sense of guilt or responsibility for a negative outcome.

examples.japanese: {自責|じせき}の{念|ねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{駆|か}られる→駆る：14715_karu⟧。
examples.english: To be driven by a sense of guilt.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{自責|じせき}の{念|ねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じている→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: He feels a sense of guilt about the accident.

examples.japanese: ⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{早|はや}く→早い：00514_hayai⟧{気|き}づいて⟦いれば→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{助|たす}けられた→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{自責|じせき}の{念|ねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれた→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧。
examples.english: I was tormented by guilt, thinking I could have helped if only I had noticed sooner.

notes:
